assessment.match_notes: No real photograph of neutral anhydrous copper(II) carbonate (CuCO3) can be verified on Wikimedia Commons. Category:Copper(II) carbonate contains only 3D ball-and-stick, space-filling and crystal-structure diagrams - no photographs. The only Commons file titled 'Copper(II) carbonate.JPG' (Chemicalinterest, PD) is categorized by the Commons community under 'Basic copper carbonate', i.e. it depicts basic copper(II) carbonate, not neutral CuCO3. All other photograph candidates are explicitly basic copper(II) carbonate samples. Chemically, neutral CuCO3 is not isolable as a stable solid under ambient conditions (it has only been synthesized under high CO2 pressure), so any ordinary 'copper carbonate' sample photo would actually show basic carbonate and would be a scientifically misleading substitute for the game's CuCO3 node.
